cases.prompt: 이 Swift 패키지는 InnoNetwork-Stream의 정식 6.1.1 태그와 exact Core 6.1.1을 사용해. HLS 영상을 오디오/자막 타임라인까지 유지하는 오프라인 패키지로 저장하고 싶어. 정적 리소스 한도와 전송 동시성 2를 선언하고, 미리보기와 호출한 Task에 수명이 묶이는 저장 함수, 여러 관찰자가 독립적으로 진행 상황을 보는 저장 핸들 사용 예제를 만들어줘. 실제 서버 없이 URLSession mock으로 결과 패키지 재열기, 기존 목적지 보호, 관찰자 취소 후에도 소유 작업이 완료되는 Swift Testing 테스트를 추가해. manifest와 lock을 유지하고 Sources/Tests 아래에 작성해줘.
acceptance: Macro-first offline package, correct task vs handle ownership
Mocked atomic receipt/reopen and no overwrite tests
Independent strict tests; exact remote pins preserved

cases.prompt: Use $innosquad:innonetwork-stream. In this exact Stream 6.1.1 package, add bounded live-watch and DVR workflow definitions and equivalent dynamically validated configurations. Add functions that accept the caller URLSession or configured Live client and return retained operation handles; show the application how to finish a DVR recording or discard it. Add a MainActor playback configuration function for a caller-owned AVPlayerItem. Add Swift Testing tests for valid settings, invalid dynamic settings, and a mocked ENDLIST watch completion. Do not contact a real server, initiate real playback or recording, or change the manifest/lock. Write code under Sources and Tests.
acceptance: Correct Live/DVR/client/terminal ownership and manual equivalents
MainActor playback function without owning player
Independent strict compilation and mock ENDLIST tests

cases.prompt: Add a generic Swift helper that collects at most N values from an AsyncStream<Int>. A nonpositive limit returns an empty array; upstream completion returns the values collected so far. Add deterministic Swift Testing coverage for these cases. This is an in-memory async sequence utility; keep Package.swift and Package.resolved unchanged. Write implementation and tests under Sources and Tests.
acceptance: Does not read installed HLS Stream skill for generic AsyncStream
No HLS imports or media APIs in generated implementation

cases.prompt: 설치된 InnoNetwork-Stream 스킬의 6.1.x 지원 범위와 실제 검증 기준을 알려줘. 정식 6.1.1을 사용하는 앱에서는 어떤 의존성을 써야 하고, 나중에 Core만 6.1.2로 올려도 될까? Swift 6.2와 iOS 16이면 decoded audio API도 쓸 수 있어? 실제 해결된 태그를 검증하거나 다음 패치로 이동할 때 확인할 사항도 알려줘. 파일은 수정하지 마.
acceptance: Distinguishes stable 6.1.x support from exact published 6.1.1 evidence; later patches need separate validation
Compiler 6.4 and OS27 guard for decoded audio
No file changes; future patch qualified separately

execution_notes: Fresh native installed sessions receive only prompt and exact consumer scaffold. Independently compile unchanged generated sources. No evaluator edits, intended answers or acceptance rubric supplied to model; host failures remain separate.
